package: رحاب المدينة — مجتمع المدينة الرقمي (Rihab Madinah)
name_status: Provisional name and typographic wordmark; no official logo and no implied affiliation
places: 257: 197 real Madinah places + 60 illustrative sample places, with the content workbook's ids (PLC-001 … PLC-257)
activities: 89: 29 experiences, 22 events, 19 activities, 19 recurring sessions (ACT-001 … ACT-089)
offers: 73: 64 illustrative deals + 9 offer pages (OFR-), attached only to sample records — never to a real place or business; shown on cards, decision pages, Home/Discover deal rails, My Plan and the Assistant; not live commercial offers
market: «السوق» / Market tab: experiences and services from the shared inventory (booked or requested from their own pages) and 10 local products (dates, gifts, crafts, perfumes) with indicative prices and a request sheet
city_opportunities: «فرص المدينة» on Home: Live in Madinah (5 homes to rent, buy or stay longer; no prices) and Invest in Madinah (an informational directory of 5 business opportunities; no amounts, returns, ratings, recommendations or owners). Not an investment service
requests: «طلباتي» / My requests: product and service requests, home details requests and registered interest, kept per account on the device only and never sent to any seller, provider or organisation; no payments
community: 178 records: 8 families, 55 communities, 10 clubs, 18 author personas, 85 posts (COM-P), 2 trust-demo claims
geography: 53 districts, 15 selectable home areas; map positions are schematic (direction and distance from the Prophet's Mosque), never GPS; places without a known district get no pin
identity: «نور» Noor (Direction A): Marble #F5F5F2 and Basalt Ink #1B2027 shared; resident Daylight — Grove #1E6A60; visitor Evening light — Fajr Blue #24548A with Night Noor #172A46; Canopy Light #F3D79E; Madani Rose #B03D5C
fonts: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, IBM Plex Sans, Noto Naskh Arabic (wordmark) from Google Fonts, with system fallbacks
media: Real places: 154 own photographs, 29 brand logos (25 supplied, reused across a brand's branches; 4 Simple Icons marks), 14 drawn category tiles (12 with no verified photograph, 2 Lulu branches whose photographs show ceremonies). Activities at a real place may show that place's photograph as context. Illustrative records: a 50-photo generic library or their category tile. No photograph of Makkah. Sources are recorded in PHOTO_SOURCES.md, never shown or explained in the app
assistant: Free-text Rihab Madinah Assistant over the four-part Intent Bank (156 intents, 2,413 AR/EN examples) — deterministic, on-device, no generative model or external API
entry: Rihab entry: one Rihab sign-in (or a new Rihab account) at the site root, then the city picker; this app opens signed in. A city has no sign-in screens of its own. The first visit to a city asks for its own profile (resident or visitor, chosen once per city), prefilled from the account
accounts: One Rihab account for both cities, on the device (hashed passwords; rihab.accounts.v1). Each city keeps its own profile, plan, communities and requests for the account
starter_plan: New accounts start with «خطة مقترحة لك» / Recommended for you: planned items from the inventory chosen per persona, using interests, area and language
experiences: One app, two experiences chosen once at profile setup and never changeable: resident (ساكن في المدينة — local life, Noor Daylight) and visitor (زائر — trip companion, Noor Evening light, no neighbourhood required). Same five tabs and one shared Save/Plan/Join/hand-off/Community/Assistant system
demo_accounts: Two Rihab demo accounts, a resident and a visitor in both cities, normal on-device accounts present on every launch; sign-in details are in the Rihab repository's README, not published with the app
platform: Part of Rihab (رحاب): one entry for Rihab Makkah and Rihab Madinah, served under /madinah/
